root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `hb_auto_t<Coverage::Iter>` is constructed from `this+coverage`, the constructor argument object observed as `t1` must alias that same Coverage object instead of a by-value copy.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable generic constructor copies the Coverage object into constructor-local `t1`, so `&t1` differs from `&(this+coverage)`. The fixed overload binds `t1` by reference, restoring the missing alias-preservation obligation at the root-cause site.

nodes.description: On the witnessed format-1 path, `Coverage::Iter::init` receives the same Coverage object address that `hb_auto_t` forwarded from its constructor argument and exposes `c_.u.format1` as the subobject later retained by the iterator.
`CoverageFormat1::Iter::init` retains the selected CoverageFormat1 subobject by storing `c = &c_` into iterator state.

When `get_glyph()` dereferences the retained CoverageFormat1 pointer, the `hb_codepoint_t` read still has an initialized-prefix shorter than `sizeof(hb_codepoint_t)`, showing that the copied-coverage pointer has become a stale uninitialized source.

The `page_for()` lookup key written from `g` still has an initialized-prefix shorter than `sizeof(key.major)`, matching MemorySanitizer's secondary "stored to memory" stack for the poisoned page-map key.
`page_map_t::cmp()` returns a comparison result whose initialized-prefix length is the same uninitialized state later branched on in `bfind()`.
At the `bfind()` branch site, the local comparison result `c` still has an initialized-prefix shorter than `sizeof(c)`, so the source-level sink branches on uninitialized data.

edges.description: The constructor forwards the same `t1` Coverage object into `Coverage::Iter::init(c_)` on the crashing path.

On the witnessed format-1 arm, `Coverage::Iter::init` passes `c_.u.format1` into `CoverageFormat1::Iter::init`, so the iterator's retained CoverageFormat1 pointer should equal that selected subobject address.

The CoverageFormat1 pointer stored in iterator state before `hb_auto_t` returns is the same pointer later dereferenced by `get_glyph()`, crossing the constructor-local lifetime boundary on the vulnerable path.
The uninitialized-byte state of the glyph scalar returned by `get_glyph()` is preserved when `c->glyphs->has(glyph_id)` forwards that same glyph into `page_for(g)`.
The `key.major` field written in `page_for()` is the exact lookup-major field later read back as `o->major` inside `page_map_t::cmp()`.
The uninitialized-byte state of the comparison result returned from `page_map_t::cmp()` is carried unchanged into the local `c` value that `bfind()` branches on.
